description: Turn the blog's email newsletter on or off. Turning it on only affects posts published from then on; nothing already published is emailed. Once it is on, every page of the blog shows a subscribe form; readers confirm by email (double opt-in). Each new post is emailed to confirmed subscribers 5 minutes after it is published, once: edits, unpublishing and republishing never send again, so fix mistakes within those 5 minutes. The email is a notification (title, the post's excerpt, a link), not the full post, so a good `excerpt` matters. Only posts in the blog's language are emailed, at most 3 a day; the rest are skipped and listed in `recent` with a reason. Pro only. Ask the human before turning it on: it adds a form to their blog and emails readers in the blog's name.

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

enabled.description: true to turn it on, false to turn it off.

name: set_newsletter

enabled.description: The owner turned the newsletter on.

live.description: The subscribe form shows and new posts are emailed: enabled, Pro, not suspended.

recent.description: The last 10 posts the newsletter handled, newest first.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or stopped: daily_cap, other_language, expired, not_pro, unpublished, deleted, newsletter_off.

sending.description: SlopIt is sending newsletter email at all right now. When false, nothing is emailed yet; subscribe requests are kept.

limit.description: Most confirmed subscribers a blog can have for now.

pending.description: Asked to subscribe, not yet confirmed from the email.

suspended.description: SlopIt stopped this blog’s newsletter; turning it on again is refused.

title: Turn newsletter on or off
